name: Codex
description: OpenAI's Codex agent via the Codex SDK. Questions to the user are multiple choice, asked at the end of a turn.

model.title: Orchestrator model
model.description: <provider>/<model> where provider must be openai, or a bare model name. Empty uses Codex's default.

effort.title: Reasoning effort
effort.description: Reasoning effort for the agent (Codex modelReasoningEffort). Empty uses the model default.
